title: Per-platform Engram binary and automated Git exchange verified on host onboarding (Windows, macOS, Linux)
outcome: Per-platform Engram binary and automated Git exchange verified on host onboarding (Windows, macOS, Linux)
acceptance: Automated task-sync Git exchange (transport and subprocess admission) runs on macOS and Linux as well as Windows, without pretending the current Windows HTTPS runner covers other platforms
Host onboarding verifies the platform's Engram binary (exact recorded sha256 and version) and a real exchange round-trip before the host is used, with the result recorded per host
Explicitly authorized manual Git remains the documented interim until a platform's automated exchange is verified
disposal_reason: Superseded as a duplicate. The automated Git exchange on Windows, macOS and Linux is w-6ea6f92ccffc (one command) plus w-6bbabe3a062b (macOS/Linux). Installing the right binary on each host is handled by procedure under rules-greg-dl560-engram-install-2026-11-06. Closed under rules-greg-close-senseless-tasks-2026-11-08; nothing is claimed as implemented.
